text_block_list.text:
Gold City has managed to leave quite a
mark on
the Twinkle Series.

Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

One day, Gold City's manager bursts
into my
office in a state of panic.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: On the cover of Il Bianco? Me?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Not only will you be the
first
representing Japan, it's an
incredible feat for any
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
It's a very well-established Italian
fashion
magazine! Getting on its cover
proves you're a
top class model!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: And they chose you to be on that cover, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously?

Gold City is speechless. I don't
recognize the
name myself, but this
magazine must be a big
deal in the
fashion world.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I mean, it doesn't feel real at all.
So, when
is the shoot?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... About that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What?! That's the day of the race!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: That's right. And the cover of Il Bianco is always shot in Italy. They've never made an exception, ever since the very first issue.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
That's why I came in person to see how
you feel.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? How I feel?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to force you to make a
choice like
this. I even considered taking
the liberty of
setting the contract up
without your input.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
But in the end, I knew I couldn't do it
without
hearing from you first.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hilarious. I've never seen you this
excited.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Be serious, City. I know it's a tough
decision to
make... but you need to
make it.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Which will you do? The photo shoot or
the race?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you think? Which
should I
choose?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh, you're right. I've made up my mind.
choice_data_list: それはシチーが1番わかってるだろう
それはシチーが1番わかってるでしょ

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll do the shoot, and I'll enter the race.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
What?! I... I was sure you'd pick the
race...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I would've a few months ago, without
skipping a
beat. After all, I like myself
best when I'm on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But I also know how much you like me as
a model.
And now... I think I can say I
do, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Because they're both me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up modeling or racing. And
that's my
answer. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: But... that's impossible! You want me to tell Il Bianco to come to Japan?!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Our... job?
choice_data_list: それが我々の仕事ですよ

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
All right. I will try to negotiate a shoot in
Japan.
But I won't need your help with
that part, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
You give City your undivided support.
We can't
make them bring their camera
crew all this way
just to see her lose.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Leave the racing business to us. If you
can make
this shoot happen, we'll
handle the rest.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll make it worth the trouble... no, more than worth the trouble for everyone involved.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I believe in you, so believe in me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that? I've never seen my
manager
look so flustered.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Am I being too selfish?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Don't you think you're spoiling
me?
choice_data_list: 全然！もっと言っていいくらい

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If you're sure, though, I do have
one more
request.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
We've got an interview after this, right?
But you
know... I've kinda got the itch.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Maybe it's the excitement from
getting such
a huge job.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But we don't have a whole lot of time.
What
should we do?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're the best! Then come to the
track
when you're done.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This might sound kind of corny since I'm,
like, so
excited, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm running, I'll always want
you to be
there watching.
